observations.passage: The Government Operations Agency, in consultation with the Governor’s Office of Emergency Services, shall, no later than November 16, 2026, submit to my office recommendations, developed in consultation with national experts, addressing the technical feasibility and potential efficacy of amendments to existing state laws regarding AI safety and security, including at least the following:
observations.limitation: Recommendation directive, not an installed shutoff.

observations.passage: Approved by Governor September 21, 2026. Filed with Secretary of State September 21, 2026.

Not later than 1 year after the date of enactment of this paragraph, each State regulatory authority (with respect to each electric utility for which the State has ratemaking authority) and each nonregulated electric utility shall commence consideration under section 111, or set a hearing date for consideration, with respect to the standard established by paragraph (22) of section 111(d).
observations.limitation: Engrossed House text; does not prove Senate passage.

observations.passage: Despite the broad targeting, findings from cybersecurity startup Gambit indicate that the attacker stole more than 600,000 valid card details from two companies and deployed skimmer malware on the websites of five other organizations to collect payment data.
observations.limitation: Independent report attributing findings to Gambit; no personal exposure notice.

observations.passage: Cowork and chat are now one Claude.
observations.limitation: Provider product statement; no individual account result.

observations.passage: GPT‑6 Sol and GPT‑6 Luna are available in ChatGPT Work and Codex starting today for all Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise, and Edu users. Free and Go users can access GPT‑6 Luna in the desktop app. These models are not yet available in Chat.
observations.limitation: Provider availability statement; gradual rollout and no account picker inspected.
